about: LaptopRecs creator-review adds (2026-11-24, PR #678): staged laptops with 3+ reviewer cards (distinct reviewers) that are not in laptoprecs.rackets. Of the 8 staged slugs the dry run could not match, 7 are already in the catalogue under another slug (db/creators/laptop-slug-aliases.json maps them), so only the HP OmniBook Ultra 14 Snapdragon X2 Elite model is new. Name in the catalogue's style for its siblings (14-fd0000, 14-kd0000); the maker page (HP Ireland, read 2026-11-24) names the SKU 'HP OmniBook Ultra Laptop Next Gen AI 14-kg0500nax'. Values read on that page; blank = not published there. Insert only after the owner's OK.
